blocking_findings.title: Unlisted public files escape privacy validation and enter manifest
blocking_findings.analytical_counterexample: Add unlisted native-grant232B.json containing agent_token. The exact listed files and both inspected projections remain unchanged; check_candidate has no predicate rejecting the extra file; manifest recursively includes it.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Enforce exact unique canonical public-file inventory closure and privacy checks across all allowed payloads/archives; add extra-file and archive negative controls.

nonblocking_findings: N1: six tests total comprise one positive and five negative controls; no execution established
N2: resolving before is_symlink loses in-record symlink identity
N3: first-repository commit/time is caller-supplied and syntactically validated, not Git-attested
N4: registry/timestamp/receipt/manifest writes are not transactional; concurrency and interruption untested
N5: archived wrapper retains local path strings, without credential files/values
